exposure: Prior health history (experiencing morbidity in the 12 months prior to first pregnancy)
cohort: A prospective cohort initially comprised of 3,047 nulliparous women who completed surveys in early pregnancy and after their first birth, with a subset of 254 women followed after their second birth.
finding: Maternal morbidities, particularly urinary incontinence, sexual health problems, depression, and anxiety, showed higher persistence rates among women who had experienced them in the 12 months prior to their first pregnancy compared to those without prior history.
followup_time: 12 months postpartum after the second birth
